verdict.rationale: Bitwarden has no built-in way to define automations that run on their own in the background. What it offers are building blocks for external automation. The personal API key is documented as suitable for automated workflows with the CLI, `bw serve` exposes the vault as a local REST API, and an official MCP server completed a live handshake. Any scheduling or autonomous agent logic must be supplied by other tools. Missing for 10: native automation or scheduling inside the product, documented background-agent workflows, and independent evidence of autonomous automations running against Bitwarden.
